title: Careers: Purified Water system roles and pay | Aquemi
meta: Process, polypropylene fabrication, validation, controls, field service and quality roles at a new Ontario maker of Purified Water (PW) systems. Pay range in every posting.
headline: Build systems that pass inspection
lead: Aquemi is a new Ontario company. We design, build, qualify and service Purified Water (PW) systems in polypropylene (PP) for drug and medical device plants. Every posting states its pay range.

items.a: Not for every role. Validation and quality roles need good manufacturing practice (GMP) experience. Fabricators, technicians and engineers from other process industries learn GMP here; documentation is half the job.

items.q: I have not joined PP piping before. Can I apply?
items.a: Yes, if you weld or fuse thermoplastic or metal pipe. The practical interview includes a polypropylene (PP) test joint by [PP joining method]. Production joints need qualification to [welder qualification standard for thermoplastics]; [PP joining qualification paid by Aquemi, yes or no].
No. We assess what you have done, wherever you did it. Engineers who seal drawings need a licence in the province of the work.
